summary.text: Jennifer Lynch is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 73 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An educator, she taught at Emerson Elementary in Butte.

paragraphs.text: Lynch was born in and lives in Butte, Montana.
Her career experience includes working as an educator at Emerson Elementary, and she became the negotiating chairperson for the Butte Teacher's Union.
Lynch took office on January 2, 2023, succeeding Democrat Jim Keane.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Education and Agriculture committees and is vice chair of the Business and Labor Committee.
